scope: Disposable APFS image and non-root writer on an ephemeral GitHub macOS runner only
interpretation: At securelevel 0, a root-set SF_IMMUTABLE flag blocked a fresh same-user writable open but did not revoke an already-open writable descriptor or shared mapping. Both existing handles changed the file while the flag remained set. The contents were read before root cleared the flag; cleanup then cleared it and ejected the disposable image. This is a negative for using the flag alone as a continuous writer fence.
